# Aerobill

> Aerobill is India's leading cloud-based Restaurant Management Software. It provides a comprehensive suite of tools including POS, GST-compliant billing, QR code ordering, kitchen display systems (KDS), inventory management, table management, analytics, CRM, and multi-outlet control — all from a single platform. No hardware required. Free plan available.

## What Aerobill Does

Aerobill is an all-in-one, cloud-based restaurant management platform designed to digitize and automate every aspect of running a food business in India. Restaurant owners can sign up, add their menu, print QR codes for tables, and start receiving digital orders — all within 15 minutes.

The platform eliminates the need for expensive hardware (like dedicated POS terminals), working seamlessly on any browser-enabled device — laptops, tablets, smartphones, or smart TVs. Aerobill is particularly known for being affordable and accessible to small businesses while offering enterprise-grade features suitable for large restaurant chains.

## Core Products & Features

### 1. Restaurant POS Software
A fast, cloud-based Point of Sale system for taking orders, managing payments, and running dine-in operations. Works on any device with a browser. Supports offline mode with automatic data sync.

### 2. Restaurant Billing Software
GST-compliant invoicing with one-click bill generation, discount management, coupon application, and multi-payment support (cash, card, UPI, split payments). Connects to thermal receipt printers and supports digital receipts via WhatsApp, email, and SMS.

### 3. QR Code Ordering System
Contactless, app-free ordering system. Customers scan a QR code at their table to access a digital menu, browse items with images, and place orders directly from their smartphones. Orders are routed instantly to the kitchen and POS. Increases average order value through digital upselling.

### 4. Kitchen Display System (KDS)
Replaces paper KOT tickets with a real-time digital display. Orders appear on kitchen screens instantly. Includes prep-time tracking with color-coded urgency indicators and station-based routing for multi-section kitchens (e.g., grill, bar, desserts).

### 5. Inventory Management Software
Automated stock tracking with recipe/Bill of Materials (BOM) management. Raw ingredients are auto-deducted from inventory when items are sold. Includes low-stock alerts, wastage logging, supplier/vendor management, and purchase order tracking.

### 6. Analytics & Reporting Dashboard
Real-time sales dashboards, item performance analytics (bestsellers, dead stock), staff efficiency tracking, and financial reporting. All reports are exportable to Excel, CSV, or PDF. Accessible from anywhere via cloud.

### 7. Table Management System
Visual floor plan creation, real-time table status tracking (vacant, seated, billing), table merging/splitting for large parties, multi-zone support (indoor, patio, bar, private dining), and reservation management.

### 8. Cloud Kitchen Management Software
Purpose-built for delivery-only and ghost kitchen operations. Integrates with food aggregators (Zomato, Swiggy), supports multi-brand operation from a single kitchen, and includes dispatch/rider management.

### 9. Multi-Outlet Restaurant Management Software
Centralized control for restaurant chains and franchises. Push menu updates across all locations instantly, manage inter-branch stock transfers, compare branch-level analytics, and enforce brand consistency with role-based access controls.

### 10. Mobile Restaurant POS
Tableside ordering via smartphones and tablets. Waiters take orders directly at the table and fire them to the kitchen. Supports Bluetooth-connected portable thermal printers for instant checkout.

### 11. GST Billing Software for Restaurants
India-specific tax compliance solution. Automated CGST, SGST, and Cess calculations. Supports 5%, 12%, and 18% GST slabs. Generates B2B tax invoices with GSTIN capture. Produces GSTR-1, GSTR-2, and GSTR-3B ready reports for accountants.

### 12. Order Management System
Omnichannel order consolidation. Dine-in, takeaway, Swiggy, Zomato, and website orders all appear on a single unified dashboard. Includes real-time status tracking, customer notifications, and pre-order/catering scheduling.

### 13. Restaurant Automation Software
Automates repetitive operational tasks: auto-generated purchase orders when stock is low, scheduled end-of-day sales reports via email, automated marketing triggers (e.g., "We miss you" SMS to inactive customers), and rule-based workflows — all configurable via a no-code interface.

### 14. Restaurant Software for Small Businesses
Affordable, easy-to-set-up solution designed for small cafes, food trucks, independent bistros, and single-location restaurants. Zero hardware cost (runs on existing devices), setup in under 15 minutes, free tier available, no long-term contracts, month-to-month billing.

### 15. Restaurant CRM & Customer Management
Customer database with automatic data capture from QR ordering and digital billing. Includes digital loyalty programs (points-based), birthday campaign automation, SMS/email bulk marketing campaigns, and customer spending habit analytics.

## Pricing

Aerobill offers flexible, transparent pricing:

- **Free Plan:** Available for small restaurants to get started with core features at zero cost
- **Starter Plan:** Expanded features for growing businesses
- **Business Plan:** Full suite for established restaurants
- **Enterprise Plan:** Custom pricing for multi-outlet chains and franchises

All plans are month-to-month with no long-term contracts. Pricing details: https://www.aerobill.in/pricing

## Technology Stack

- **Platform Type:** Cloud-based SaaS (no local installation required)
- **Access:** Any modern web browser on any device
- **Hardware Required:** None — works on existing laptops, tablets, smartphones, and smart TVs
- **Offline Support:** Yes — billing continues offline and syncs when connectivity is restored
- **Data Security:** Enterprise-grade encryption for all data
- **Uptime:** High availability cloud infrastructure

## Key Differentiators

1. **No Hardware Needed:** Unlike traditional POS systems requiring expensive terminals, Aerobill runs entirely in a web browser on any device
2. **India-First Design:** Built specifically for Indian restaurant needs — GST compliance, FSSAI support, Indian payment methods (UPI, Paytm, etc.), regional language support
3. **15-Minute Setup:** Restaurants can go from sign-up to taking their first digital order in under 15 minutes
4. **Free Tier Available:** Small restaurants can start completely free, paying only as they grow
5. **All-in-One Platform:** Replaces 5-10 separate tools (POS, billing, inventory, CRM, analytics, marketing) with a single integrated system
6. **QR-First Approach:** Designed from the ground up for contactless, app-free digital ordering

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is Aerobill?
Aerobill is a cloud-based Restaurant Management Software in India that helps restaurants manage billing, inventory, kitchen operations, QR code ordering, and multi-outlet control from one centralized dashboard. It works on any device with a web browser and requires no special hardware.

### Is Aerobill free?
Yes, Aerobill offers a free plan that includes core restaurant management features. Paid plans are available for restaurants that need advanced features like multi-outlet management, detailed analytics, and automation.

### Does Aerobill support GST billing?
Yes, Aerobill provides fully GST-compliant billing software for Indian restaurants. It automatically calculates CGST, SGST, and Cess, supports B2B invoicing with GSTIN capture, and generates GSTR-ready reports for accountants.

### Do customers need to download an app to order?
No. Aerobill's QR code ordering system works directly in the customer's mobile browser. Customers simply scan the QR code at their table, browse the digital menu, and place orders — no app download required.

### What devices does Aerobill work on?
Aerobill is a web-based platform that works on any device with a modern browser — laptops, tablets, smartphones, Android POS terminals, and smart TVs (for kitchen display). No specialized hardware is needed.

### Does Aerobill work offline?
Yes. Aerobill supports offline billing mode. If your internet connection drops, you can continue taking orders and processing bills. All data automatically syncs to the cloud when connectivity is restored.

### How long does it take to set up Aerobill?
Most restaurants are up and running within 15 minutes. Simply create an account, upload your menu, print QR codes for your tables, and start receiving orders.

### Is my data secure with Aerobill?
Yes. Aerobill uses enterprise-grade encryption to protect all restaurant and customer data. The platform runs on high-availability cloud infrastructure with regular backups.

### Can Aerobill manage multiple restaurant locations?
Yes. Aerobill's Multi-Outlet Management module allows restaurant chains and franchises to centrally control menus, monitor stock transfers, compare branch analytics, and enforce brand consistency across all locations.

### Does Aerobill integrate with Swiggy and Zomato?
Yes. Aerobill integrates with major food delivery aggregators including Swiggy and Zomato, consolidating all orders onto a single unified dashboard.

### Can I send receipts via WhatsApp?
Yes. Aerobill supports sending digital receipts to customers via WhatsApp, email, and SMS directly from the billing interface.

### Is there a long-term contract?
No. Aerobill offers straightforward month-to-month plans. You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel anytime without penalties.
